ferritin_geometric_mean_reconciliation: Apply one common multiplicative factor to the three reported conditional geometric means, preserving their ratios while matching the reported overall geometric mean.
within_hb_stratum_dependence: Hemoglobin is independent of depletion status and ferritin conditional on the three-level hemoglobin stratum.
numerical_safety: Exponentiation is bounded to log values [-700,700]; floating-point threshold guards preserve category membership. These are numerical safeguards, not realized-sample calibration.
